verdict.rationale: Ashby exposes an API with pagination/sync-tokens and webhooks that can support scripted bulk actions, and Ashby Assistant can act across records via chat, but there is no documented native bulk-edit UI or explicit 'bulk operation' endpoint for acting on many candidates/jobs simultaneously. missing for 10: explicit bulk-update/bulk-action API endpoints or UI feature, independent confirmation of bulk workflows succeeding at scale, and evidence Assistant/agents can reliably batch-process large sets of items rather than one-by-one.
